package.name: nanoflann_vendor
package.description: Workspace-local copy of nanoflann 1.11.0 (header-only), taken from the ros-humble-nanoflann 1.11.0 Debian package. Installed only into this workspace so that mola_metric_maps can build mola::IncrementalPointCloud without changing the system-wide nanoflann (1.4.2 in /usr/include), which other packages such as krowd_route_mapper compile against through MRPT.
